additional_info.body: The charger is frequently switch between unavailable and available throughout the day. additional_info.subject: RE: ID0412935-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / P3 170000343] The charger is frequently switch between unavailable and available CRM:00641001218
additional_info.body:
Dear Mark Wilson,
Hope you are doing well.
As per the reported timestamp, we have checked the logs and identified that the charger is frequently switching between
unavailable
and
available
due to a
PLC communication error
and an
invalid insulation monitor state
.
We’d like to inform you that the
COAP error
you’ve encountered is caused by an interruption in the internal communication between the
SiC D
and the
SECC
. Please rest assured that this is a temporary issue, and the SiC D will automatically reconnect to the SECC within approximately
5 seconds
.
Here we can see the charger outlet came back online within
3 seconds.

bug fixes

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0412935-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / P3 170000343] The charger is frequently switch between unavailable and available CRM:00641001218
additional_info.body:
Hey All,
Update on the FW process for these chargers.
We can begin the rollout at any time the charger is online (even if it is charging), this is the process of downloading the image onto the charger.
The activation is the stage where the new image is then applied to the charger, during which the charger should not be charging and the charger should remain on.
I started today (as part of our normal workflow) rolling out version 5.0.23 ready for tomorrow’s activation ahead of time.
For charger 170000343, this is happening now, however for 170000340, it already has a previous image loaded onto it (version 4.0.11), this is not allowing me to download the image 5.0.23 now.
I have raised this with the case agent and he is taking this to the development team, as it is not within out access rights to perform the clearing of an already downloaded image (normally it gets activated and all is good).
Given the short notice, it might be unlikely the product team can attend to this tonight.
This then gives us the following options, which I would like you to consider and advise us which you think is best:
1) Proceed to update charger 170000343 only to version 6.1.3 tomorrow, leaving 170000340 with 4.0.11
2) Postpone the FW update for both chargers until 170000340 is able to be updated as well.
I apologies about this inconvenience.
If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to contact me directly about it.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Phone: +61 499 701 794
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0412935-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / P3 170000343] The charger is frequently switch between unavailable and available CRM:00641001218
additional_info.body:
Hey Mark,
Thanks for the feedback, we will progress charger 170000343 to 6.0.3.
For Charger 170000340, the case has been escalated to the Expert services team but has not progressed yet.
The possible cause is because an image of 4.0.11 is already preloaded onto the charger, when this was downloaded to the charger I am unsure.
Based off the process flow, at our service level access, we can activate firmware that has been downloaded to the charger, but we cannot delete images that have been downloaded.
Because an image is already loaded onto the charger it is not allowing another image to be loaded onto it (in this case 5.0.23).
In short, we can not rollout version 5.0.23 on this charger, because it already has version 4.0.11 rolled out (and ready for activation), even though it already has 4.0.11.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
